`omarchy-clamshell.sh` is an unmodified copy of Omarchy's wake/clamshell script:
https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/9285b19d6a72eba3df8537d62a4cd5506a803d89/bin/omarchy-hyprland-monitor-clamshell

It is used only by the isolated regression test for #58. All desktop commands
and HOME are replaced by test fixtures. Its MIT license is in OMARCHY-LICENSE.
